limitations: One fixed synthetic midpoint recipient and two known positioned-QKV source banks.
Conditional native primitives, not independent Flash/GEMM implementation.
No raw-prompt, suffix, VAE or semantic claim; effects are not causal shares.
metric_orientation: native minus predicted; finite contrasts follow named case ordering

native_contract.intervention: dispatch inputs only; original SDPA return is not replaced; no fabricated Act receipt
native_contract.recipient: same midpoint image/residual/modulation/text/RoPE/clock for every branch

predeclared_expectations.controls: 00 at midpoint residual should replay the earlier fixed-sham-head prediction;11 should replay the earlier midpoint native image. 00 is not a historical sham block.
predeclared_expectations.exploratory: Relative query/bank effects, their sign, interaction and downstream roles are not assumed; preserve all signed values without a dominance gate.
predeclared_expectations.numerical: All four complete image-write forecasts and their signed contrasts should have exact value equality under original-policy native primitives; retain misses.
predeclared_expectations.text_separation: The two source text-Q portions are unchanged; at each fixed bank, changing image Q alone should leave the current block text exit exactly unchanged.
